name: NeutrinoAPI
description: A Drupal service wrapper around the NeutrinoAPI data/analysis service (email/IP/UA lookups).
project_description:
Neutrino API is a collection of general-purpose APIs that solve common and recurring problems encountered during software development.

 
 Neutrino API requires a non-free subscription to a third-party service. This module is not intended to serve as an advertisement, or provide SEO services for Neutrino. The maintainer is not associated with Neutrino, but simply loves how easy to use and powerful it is! 
 The Neutrino API module provides a Drupal service wrapper around the Neutrino data validation client library and a set of opinionated submodules to provide an array of quality of life enhancements.

 Features 
 The core of the module provides a ready to use Neutrino API drupal service that encourages and facilitates the secure configuration of API keys. Opinionated submodules include:

 Neutrino API Email Validator 
 This submodule decorates the pre-existing email validator service through the Neutrino Email Validate API. It also provides an extended interface that offers additional data points that can be very useful for error messaging and/or further customization to the validator. Check out the API documentation for information on what new data points are available.

 Post-Installation 
 The module must be configured with a set of valid API credentials. Using the key module is highly encouraged.

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 The key module is highly recommended to securely store the API client credentials.
